title: Frobenius--Tschirnhausen ampleness
summary: We study smooth projective varieties whose Frobenius-trace kernel, also known as the Tschirnhausen bundle associated with the Frobenius morphism, is ample. We show that any non-constant morphism out of such a variety must be finite onto its image, providing strong evidence that these varieties must be Fano varieties of Picard rank 1.
